newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers no peak, firm power for Friday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers no peak, firm power for Friday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) did not offer any peak firm power for Friday deliveries, while other next-day prices were unchanged, the agency said Thursday.
For Thursday pre-schedulings, BPA had offered 200 megawatts (MW) of firm power during peak demand hours at $15.00-16.00 per megawatt hour (MWh).
For Friday, BPA continued to offer unlimited firm power during light load hours at $9.00 a MWh.
BPA also left Friday prices for non-firm power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT unchanged at $7.00 per MWh for Northwest sales and $8.00 for California-Oregon border.
Prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0600-0700 and 2300 PDT were also unchanged at $10.00 for all deliveries.
